claim_found_on_2010_2021: when VIX is high against its own history so far (expanding percentile), the next-21-day market return is higher
confirmation_data: S&P 500 index (^GSPC, price only) and ^VIX, 1990-2009 and 2022-2026: periods not used to find the claim. Index level only; no individual stocks after 2021.
test: rank correlation of vix_pct (expanding percentile, 252-day minimum) with the next-21-day index return; Newey-West t with 20 lags; identical to the original test
confirmed_if: the correlation is positive in BOTH new periods AND its t-statistic exceeds 2 on the two new periods pooled
secondary: vix_slope (VIX3M / VIX - 1) on 2022-2026 only (VIX3M does not exist before 2006); reported, not decided on
range_forecast_methods: M0 trailing 20-day volatility with normal quantiles (the original approach)
M1 trailing volatility with empirical quantiles
M2 model volatility (pooled walk-forward regression) with empirical quantiles
M3 M2 plus a VIX-conditional centre
range_forecast_scoring: out of sample 2012-2021, S&P 500 members: share of outcomes inside the 50% and 90% bands, average width, interval score (lower is better)
strategy_scoring: weekly rebalance, 5 bp on turnover, 2012-2021; Sharpe ratio and worst drawdown averaged over stocks, and for AAPL
known_weakness: the features in the volatility model were chosen after seeing 2010-2021, the same period it is scored on
